findings.claim: DepthStep comparison was loosened from `>=` to `>`, so MessagePackSecurity.MaximumObjectGraphDepth now permits one extra nesting level (limit+1) before throwing InsufficientExecutionStackException. This weakens the recursion depth limit for untrusted data and is unrelated to the SuppressSourceGeneration analyzer requirement. The effect is an off-by-one, but it alters a security-relevant boundary and could change behavior for callers who set the depth to a tight value (e.g. 0 or 1 now allows nesting).

receipt_plan.detail: Set MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.WithMaximumObjectGraphDepth(N), deserialize a nested array structure of exactly N+1 levels, and assert InsufficientExecutionStackException is thrown. It passes on base and fails on head. Also test with MaximumObjectGraphDepth = 0 or 1.
